detail.message: The evidence package is 60,000 tokens; only 2 of the 3 panel seats can read that much. example-provider/panel-2 can read up to 40,000 tokens. A seat gives evidence half of its context window after reserving room for its answer and prompt; the other half is kept for the panel's discussion. Narrow the evidence (line ranges or fewer includes) or set a smaller roster in the project's athena.members setting. Nothing was sent to a model and no evidence was cut.
